name: Idli with Sambar and Chutney
instructions: 1. Soak rice and urad dal separately for 4-6 hours, then grind into a smooth batter and ferment overnight.
2. Steam the batter in an idli mould for 10-12 minutes.
3. For Sambar, pressure cook toor dal with vegetables, then simmer with tamarind extract and homemade sambar powder.
4. Temper the sambar with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and asafoetida.
5. For chutney, grind coconut, roasted gram, green chillies, and ginger into a paste, then temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
description: Idli with Sambar and Chutney is the quintessential South Indian breakfast. It is a highly nutritious, fermented dish that is culturally ingrained in the daily lives of Tamilians, often symbolizing a healthy start to the day and traditional home hospitality.
